name: cf-browser
description: A shared Cloudflare Browser Run browser: persistent logins, independent agent tabs, interactive Live View and verified cleanup when work finishes.

interface.longDescription: Work with persistent Cloudflare logins across Codex and Claude Code on the same machine. Each agent owns stable tabs, actions return fresh observations, and you can take a tab through interactive Live View. The shared manager saves the profile and confirms remote closure when all tasks and human control finish. Advanced crawl, reads, replay and WebMCP are discovered when needed.
